# GitHub Copilot instructions

Apply the project rules in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md). For a game-development
task, first read
`.opencode/skills/universal-game-development-engineer/SKILL.md` and the relevant
reference files.

Inspect the current engine version, project structure, assets and tests before
making changes. Discover MCP tools at runtime. Preserve user work, verify asset
licenses, avoid placeholder/fake gameplay, and distinguish configured,
implemented, compiled, tested and verified results. Do not fabricate screenshots,
tool availability or test output.
